pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)The quartz fiber is used to share power between $(l:ae2_mechanics/me_network_connections)networks$(/l), while keeping them separate. This allows you to power $(l:ae2_mechanics/subnetworks)subnetworks$(/l) without needing to put energy acceptors and power cables everywhere. It can also be used to keep cables from connecting, although using cables of differing colors, or using
$(l:items_blocks_machines/cable_anchor)Cable Anchor$(/l) is cheaper and more effective.$(br2)They are $(l:ae2_mechanics/cable_subparts)cable subparts$(/l).
